verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a raw REST API (POST to /tax/products, /tax/calculations, /tax/transactions), an MCP server, Claude skills, and platform integrations, but no official Numeral client SDK in any language. The only SDK mention refers to a third-party LLM SDK on the client side, which is not a Numeral SDK. An official SDK is a fair question for an API product, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
